prompt: Subject: Morning bed with floral dress Subject: A 20-something woman sitting against a wall on a white bed with both knees raised to her chest. Most of her body is placed in the center-right of the screen, featuring a pale small floral pattern dress, a large white ribbon at the chest, and white ribbon socks. Person/Expression: Rounded oval face with a small jaw, large dark brown eyes, thin arched eyebrows, a small nose, and pale coral lips. Head tilted slightly to the left, looking at the camera with a gentle, relaxed expression. Dark brown hair loosely tied up with thin bangs, long stray hairs by the cheeks, and a pale pink flower ornament at the back of the head. Clothing/Pose: A thin-strap ruffled dress with a white base and small pink, blue, and yellow floral patterns. Clear small ornaments on the straps, a large white satin ribbon in the center of the chest, a form-fitting bodice, and a multi-layered sheer skirt. Short white socks with ruffled tops and ribbons on the outer ankles. Both knees bent together, supporting herself with her right hand on the bed. Background/Light: Pale beige wall on the right, window with white lace curtains on the left, white cabinet, pink and white vase, and a frilled lampshade table lamp. Soft diffused light from the window on the left brightens the face, chest, and legs uniformly, casting very faint shadows toward the wall. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Full-body portrait from a front camera slightly overlooking the bed. Face in the upper third right, bent knees placed large in the center left, socks and toes cut off at the bottom. Focus on the person, with a shallow depth of field lightly blurring the vase and window. Texture/Style: Photorealistic live-action photo taken in soft white natural light. Detailed depiction of skin texture, chiffon transparency, satin ribbons, sock stitches, and bedding lace. Negative: Significant change in facial features; change in pose with knees raised to the chest.

promptZh: 主体：晨间床铺与碎花裙 主体：一位 20 多岁 的女性，背靠墙壁坐在白色床上，双膝抬起至胸前。她的大部分身体位于画面中右侧，身着 浅色小碎花 连衣裙，胸前饰有巨大的白色丝带，并穿着带有白色丝带的短袜。人物/表情：圆润的鹅蛋脸，下巴小巧，深棕色大眼睛，细长的拱形眉毛，小巧的鼻子，淡珊瑚色嘴唇。头部微微向左倾斜，以温柔放松的表情注视着镜头。深棕色头发松散地扎起，留有稀疏的刘海，脸颊旁有几缕长发，后脑勺戴着一个 淡粉色 花朵饰品。服装/姿势：细肩带荷叶边连衣裙，白色底色，配有粉色、蓝色和黄色的小碎花图案。肩带上有精致的小饰品，胸前正中饰有巨大的白色缎面丝带，紧身胸衣设计，裙摆为多层透明材质。穿着带有荷叶边袜口和外踝丝带的白色短袜。双膝并拢弯曲，右手支撑在床上。背景/光线：右侧为浅米色墙壁，左侧为带有白色蕾丝窗帘的窗户，配有白色柜子、粉白相间的花瓶以及带有褶边灯罩的台灯。左侧窗户射入柔和的漫射光，均匀地照亮了面部、胸部和腿部，在墙上投下极淡的阴影。构图/相机：3:4 竖构图。从略微俯视床铺的正面视角拍摄的全身肖像。面部位于右上三分之一处，弯曲的双膝占据画面左侧中心位置，袜子和脚趾在底部被裁切。焦点集中在人物身上，浅景深效果使花瓶和窗户呈现轻微模糊。质感/风格：在柔和的白色自然光下拍摄的写实真人照片。细腻地刻画了皮肤质感、雪纺透明度、缎面丝带、袜子缝线以及床品的蕾丝细节。负面提示词：面部特征发生显著变化；改变双膝抬至胸前的姿势。
